name: s3d-plugin-layout
description: LayOut for Shap3D.ai: sheets for plans next to the 3D model – viewports from scenes with a drawing scale, live linked to the model, text, lines, dimensions, title block, SVG export and printing to PDF.

scripts.screenshots: powershell -File ../../scripts/screenshots.ps1 -Shots script -Name layout -Out docs -Query "package=layout&file=/plugins/layout/docs/demo.js&command=layout.fromScenes" && powershell -File ../../scripts/screenshots.ps1 -Shots script -Name layout-plan -Out docs -Query "package=layout&file=/plugins/layout/docs/demo-plan.js&command=layout.open"
scripts.screenshots:sh: bash ../../scripts/screenshots.sh --shots script --name layout --out docs --query "package=layout&file=/plugins/layout/docs/demo.js&command=layout.fromScenes" && bash ../../scripts/screenshots.sh --shots script --name layout-plan --out docs --query "package=layout&file=/plugins/layout/docs/demo-plan.js&command=layout.open"
